//: Sample sky-eye config — copy to <repo>/.sky-eye/config.json and adjust.
narrate    — chapter narratives + LLM attention marks
classify   — per-line attention marks (shares one call with narrate
here, since both resolve to the same adapter)
chunk      — semantic chapter grouping (titles + reading order)
classifier — separate per-line decision pass (OpenAI Decisions API)
Credentials: the claude-code provider runs each task through the `claude`
CLI (subscription auth — run `claude auth login` once, keep the binary on
PATH); the classifier reads OPENAI_API_KEY from the env (or set "apiKey"
below). Missing credentials → that task is skipped, never a hard failure.
sky-eye ignores unknown keys, so "//" keys are safe to keep as comments.
This file can also live machine-wide at ~/.config/sky-eye/config.json
per field, so put secrets/defaults here and repo-specific overrides there.

defaults.//: Claude subscription — check the exact model id your plan offers, e.g. fall back to "claude-haiku-4-5" if 5.5 isn't listed yet.

classifier.//: All keys below are optional: model (default gpt-6-luna), apiKey (OPENAI_API_KEY env works), timeoutMs (30000), fallback (true — rules marks survive a failed run), debug (false — full transcript into classifier.log).
